brief:
Sixty-nine Palestinian remains have been recovered in northern Gaza, enabling families to conduct burials after bodies lay trapped beneath debris for years, Al Jazeera English reported. The recoveries represent a significant development for families unable to lay their relatives to rest following prolonged displacement and blocked access to affected areas.

The discovery allows grieving families to perform funeral rites and find closure following an extended period of displacement that prevented identification and burial of the deceased.
dek: The remains of 69 Palestinians have been recovered in northern Gaza, allowing families to bury them.
title: Gaza families bury Palestinians found under rubble after years
